### Dusty Pages — *Friendship Is Magic* (G4)

**Who she is:** Twilight Sparkle’s former favorite **head librarian at Canterlot Library**. In **“The Point of No Return” (season 9, episode 5; 2019)**, Twilight thinks her years-overdue book got Dusty fired. In fact, Dusty **left voluntarily** after realizing she no longer wanted to chase a perfect record. Twilight finds her enjoying retirement at Silver Stable, playing guitar and pursuing theater, woodworking, windsurfing, and even fruit fights. [Episode dialogue](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/Transcripts/The_Point_of_No_Return).

**Recognize her:** An older **Earth-pony mare** with a soft bluish-lavender/gray coat, pale pink-and-white mane and tail, golden-orange eyes, and a book-themed cutie mark. [Character reference (community-maintained draft)](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/My_Little_Pony_Friendship_is_Magic_Wiki%3AWorkshop/Dusty_Pages).

**Name and voice:** **Dusty Pages** is spoken in the episode itself, not merely a fandom-assigned name. She has substantial dialogue; **Ellen Kennedy** is credited as her English-language voice. No separate alter ego, stage name, or production alias was verified. [Episode cast](https://pro.imdb.com/title/tt10084434/).

**Appearances:** Major supporting role in **“The Point of No Return”**. A community-maintained character reference also reports a brief cameo at Twilight’s coronation in **“The Last Problem”** (S9E26); that minor appearance is not independently confirmed here.

**Episode still:** Dusty is the pale-maned mare **playing guitar in the foreground**.
